samples.xml_description:
<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>A sequence detector to detect a specific 4-bit binary sequence 1001.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">The active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">A 1-bit binary input signal representing the current bit being processed.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">A 1-bit output signal indicating whether the specified sequence has been successfully detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Waiting for the start of the sequence.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">First bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">Second bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">Third bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">Fourth and final bit of the desired sequence detected.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="next_state">The next state of the state machine.</signal>
        <reg id="current_state">The current state of the state machine.</reg>
        <assign id="seq_detected_reg">A register to store the detection result.</assign>
        <always_comb>
            // Combinational logic for determining the next state based on the current state and input
            case(current_state)
                IDLE : begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = S1;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                S1 : begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = S2;
                    else
                        next_state = S1;
                end
                S2 : begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = S3;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                S3 : begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = S4;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                default : begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = S1;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        </always_comb>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge reset_n)>
            if(reset_n)
                current_state <= IDLE;
            else
                current_state <= next_state;
        </always_ff>
        
        <always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge reset_n)>
            if(reset_n)
                seq_detected_reg <= 1'b0;
            else if(next_state == S4 && data_in == 1'b1)
                seq_detected_reg <= 1'b1;
            else
                seq_detected_reg <= 1'b0;
        </always_ff>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>The sequence detector uses a finite state machine (FSM) with states such as IDLE, S1, S2, and S3. It detects the sequence 1001 based on the input bits received sequentially. Upon detecting the sequence, the output sequence_detected is set to 'high'.</implementation>
    <task id="initialization">
        <description>Initialize the state machine and the internal registers during reset.</description>
        <code>
            current_state <= IDLE;
            seq_detected_reg <= 1'b0;
        </code>
    </task>
</module>
